title: Profiled compile verdict: projected rule unconditionally, DS14 companion rule only along certified sequences
statement: On the population-conditionally-centered scalar class (d_psi = d_lambda = 1): (a) the projected efficient-score interval rule is the only CURRENTLY ESTABLISHED unconditional compile path in the registered theory, not a mathematical uniqueness theorem. By the DS16 funnel, every asymptotically value-convergent free-optimizer sequence is nuisance-degenerate, so refusal to compile a free profiled terminal remains the safe default. (b) DS14 supplies only a sequence-conditional companion-rule theorem; one finite stable fit passing measured margins remains diagnostic, not a population certificate. Report the observable finite gap v_hat_K - Phi_hat_s; delta(kappa) is existential. (c) Audit-hardened DS17 proves that, on atomless (L)+(M1)+(M4) laws, almost surely all sufficiently large samples have no ordinary exchange-stable labeling satisfying fixed (M2)+(M3)+(M5), so the full-triple DS14 path is asymptotically vacuous there. With (M5) dropped, LCM stationary configurations may retain margins only in coincident projected-centroid splits whose compilable reduction has rank at most one. Outside (L), DS18 now proves one exact positive case: for S=(X,3X^2-1+Z) with iid uniform X,Z and K=3, every finite global regular profiled-optimum sequence converges to a full-rank companion basin with fixed margins. This is a law-specific global-oracle existence theorem, not a practical compile guarantee; raw population labels can be finite exchange-unstable, and general/mix3 selection remains open. DS18 has now passed its independent adversarial audit (AUDIT-DS-NONCENTERED-GLOBAL-BASIN-TRANSFER, 31 Aug 2026) and is verified with hardened assumptions; the audit changes no compile verdict, and it adds one requirement for any future profiled surface: the in-bin (DS9) feasibility convention must be stated, because under a pseudo-inverse comparison domain a global optimum over regular labelings need not be exchange-stable at all (CE-DS-NONCENTERED-SINGULAR-DESTINATION-001). The projected rule attains v_K only in the distinct formulation with nuisance information supplied externally or unbinned.
assumptions: class (L)+(S), d_psi = d_lambda = 1, equal weights, exact scores; the conditional path's asymptotic guarantee is DS14's and inherits (M1)-(M5), or the merged variant, along a sequence
a per-fit measured triple plus exact exchange stability is diagnostic only and is not a finite-sample population certificate

off class (L), DS18 proves an exact K=3 bounded-law global-optimum transfer, audited and hardened 31 Aug 2026 under the in-bin (DS9) feasibility convention; practical local-solver selection and robust law classes remain open
